description:
Get a ticker's registration status

Whether a ticker has a registration, and if so who holds it: `status` is `confirmed` (a registration exists on chain), `pending` or `confirming` (a token launched through Chain Daddy whose registration is still being written; `owner` is its creator) or `available` (none). It answers with ONE registration, the first found; a ticker can be registered on several chains, each by the holder of its own token, and the others are not in this answer. `available` here does not mean every chain is free.
name: get_registration

owner.description: The holder; for a pending registration, the token's creator

tierCount.description: How many holder tiers the token page has set up

txHash.description: Pending transaction hash (only when isPending is true)

title: Get a ticker's registration
